verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a format-conversion tool, so format coverage is a fair question to ask of it. However, its documented 200+ formats are bitmap image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF), and nothing in the evidence shows conversion between Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB or DOCX.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other
